newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chubais drops Eurobond chief from Russian ministry.
newsitem.headline: Chubais drops Eurobond chief from Russian ministry.

text.p: Russian Finance Minister Anatoly Chubais named three first deputy ministers on Thursday but did not include Andrei Vavilov, formerly in charge of Eurobond issues and Paris and London Club relations.

Chubais, who was appointed Finance Minister and First Deputy Prime Minister in a new reform cabinet last month, told reporters Alexei Kudrin, Vladimir Petrov and Sergei Ignatyev would be first deputies.
Asked specifically about Vavilov, Chubais responded, "Vavilov's fate is decided."

Vavilov, a first deputy finance minister since 1992, was spokesman for the ministry and in charge of the hard currency and external relations departments. He was also chairman of the intra-government commission on foreign debt.
Interfax news agency said Vavilov could move to Bank MFK, though neither MFK nor the finance ministry confirmed that information.
